date.basis: Timeline A.1 (pdf p.52) and §1.2 (pdf pp.72-73); the apology is dated 8 Rajab 829/16 May 1426 (pdf p.55, note 2).

description: Yazd enemies, angered by his impartial application of the Shariʿa, send a delegation to Herat and cite a youthful verse praising ʿAlī; Shāhrukh summons him, and he writes Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I and the R. Iʿtiqādāt, regaining Shāhrukh's favour.
